notes: MLXUI-authored (RSI/DelegateModelPackBacklog.md MP2-W) -- catflow-mlx has no manifest for this model, so this was written in the shape of voxtral-mini-4b-realtime-2602-4bit.json. It has no checksum field, as the other MLXUI-authored manifests (the Gemma 4 pair, MiMo, Qwen3.8) have none: there is no catflow source manifest to inherit one from and the field is documentary. settings is empty on purpose (readme T4): the engine takes no language and returns text only, so no lang or timestamps setting is offered. resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (2.51) and resources.ram_gb is its ramGB 3.77 (download size x 1.5, MP-0 G: an estimate, not a measurement).
